exact.保持比例，适配指定范围，不放大图片。: Fit within the specified size. No upscaling.
exact.按指定宽高调整，可能拉伸图片。: Use exact dimensions. This may stretch the image.
exact.只删除应用内部副本，原文件和已保存的副本不受影响。: Only app copies are deleted. Originals and exported files are kept.
exact.图片、视频默认保存到相册；其他文件选择保存位置。: Images and videos save to Photos. Choose a location for other files.
exact.颜色随深浅外观柔和适配，保持文字清晰。: Colors adapt softly to the theme for readable text.
exact.液态玻璃转换按钮，向上拖至中央松手: Drag the glass control to the center and release to convert
exact.内容过大，无法在应用内预览: This content is too large to preview in the app
exact.文档结构过于复杂，无法预览: This document is too complex to preview
exact.手机无法解码此图片，文件仍然保留。: Your device cannot decode this image. The file is kept.
exact.手机无法解码这个GIF，文件仍然保留: Your device cannot decode this GIF. The file is kept.
exact.手机无法解码这张背景图片: Your device cannot decode this background image
exact.无法保存背景图片: Unable to save the background image
exact.请选择系统授权的图片: Choose an image using the system picker
exact.内容预览：不还原排版/图片，不重新计算公式；表格最多200行、16列: Content preview: no original layout, images or formula calculation. Up to 200 rows and 16 columns.
exact.此格式暂不支持应用内内容预览。原文件已保留，可直接分享给支持它的应用。: In-app preview is unavailable for this format. The file is kept and can be shared to a compatible app.
exact.未获相册权限，可保存到文件: Photo permission was denied. You can save to Files.
exact.请从已完成列表继续保存其余文件: Save the remaining files from Completed files
exact.请等待当前任务结束: Wait for the current task to finish
exact.请等待当前任务结束，或点击取消: Wait for the current task, or tap Cancel
exact.合并至少需要两份 PDF: Select at least two PDFs to merge
exact.当前系统低于 Android 13：支持文件转换，但不能呈现 RuntimeSh: Full shader refraction needs Android 13 or later. File conversion remains available.
exact.所有转换在本机完成。最多 20 份输入、单份 512 MiB、合计 1 GiB。: All conversions run on device. Up to 20 inputs, 512 MiB each and 1 GiB total. Documents rebuild text only, without OCR. MP3 encoding is unavailable; video encoding depends on device codecs.
exact.GIF不含声音；尺寸、帧率和片段长度共同决定体积。: GIF has no audio. Size, frame rate and duration determine file size.
exact.降低分辨率、码率或帧率可以减小文件；转码可能有画质损失。: Lower resolution, bitrate or frame rate reduces file size. Transcoding can reduce quality.
exact.GIF最长60秒，有处理量限制。Live Photo需导入MOV视频，或同名照片: GIF is limited to 60 seconds and a processing budget. For Live Photo, import its MOV video or matching photo/MOV pair. A still image alone cannot restore motion.
exact.编码器和分辨率支持取决于手机；不会把不支持的HEVC/AV1悄悄替换为H.264: Codec and resolution support depend on the device. Unsupported HEVC/AV1 will not be silently replaced with H.264.
exact.截取片段，调整尺寸、帧率和质量；不含声音。: Trim a clip and adjust size, frame rate and quality. No audio.
exact.MP4输出；可调分辨率、码率、帧率和截取范围，仅使用本机实际编码器。: MP4 output with size, bitrate, frame rate and trim options. Uses available device encoders.
exact.从Motion Photo或Live Photo配对中取出视频部分并输出MP4。: Extract the video from a Motion Photo or Live Photo pair as MP4.
exact.导出截取起点的一帧画面。: Export a frame at the selected start time.
exact.透明图片转 JPG 会铺白；GIF 只处理首帧。: JPEG fills transparency with white. Only the first GIF frame is converted.
exact.按所选顺序，每张图片一页。: One image per page, in the selected order.
exact.每页导出为独立图片。: Export each page as a separate image.
exact.至少两份 PDF；原数字签名不保留。: At least two PDFs. Original digital signatures are not retained.
exact.每页一个 PDF，可指定页码。: One PDF per page, with optional page selection.
exact.只重建文字，不保留版式或图片；无 OCR。: Rebuilds text only. No original layout, images or OCR.
exact.仅首个工作表，不计算公式，不保留样式。: First worksheet only. No formula calculation or original styles.
exact.不支持 RAR5、分卷或链接；最多 2000 项 / 1 GiB。: No RAR5, multipart archives or links. Up to 2,000 entries / 1 GiB.
exact.M4A 提取 AAC；WAV 使用手机解码器。: M4A extracts AAC. WAV uses the device decoder.
exact.ZIP 支持 AES 密码，TAR.GZ 无密码。: ZIP supports AES passwords. TAR.GZ has no password.
exact.向下拖动关闭面板: Drag down to close the panel
exact.正在进行的本地转换、导入和保存任务: On-device conversion, import and save tasks
exact.可切到后台，任务会继续: You can leave the app. Processing continues in the background.
exact.图片过大，请选择更小的输出尺寸: Image is too large. Choose a smaller output size.
exact.自定义宽高应在1–32768之间: Custom width and height must be between 1 and 32768
exact.图片尺寸过大，请开启高级选项选择较小尺寸: Image is too large. Enable advanced settings and choose a smaller size.
exact.原尺寸图片内存需求过高，请开启高级设置选择4K或更小尺寸: The original image needs too much memory. Enable advanced settings and choose 4K or smaller.
exact.手机内存不足，请减少文件或尺寸: Not enough memory. Use fewer files or a smaller output size.
exact.密码错误或文件已加密，请检查密码: The password is incorrect or the file is encrypted. Check the password.
exact.系统后台处理时限已到，任务已中止，原文件保留: The system background time limit was reached. Processing stopped; originals are kept.
exact.这是本机错误报告，不代表问题已修复。请复制报告发给开发者定位。原文件和转换结果不: This is a local error report. Copy it to help the developer diagnose the issue. Your files are kept; the report is not uploaded automatically.
exact.清除诊断并退出，下次打开重试: Clear report and exit. Try opening again.
exact.任务已提交或另一项操作仍在运行: This task was already submitted, or another task is running
exact.只接受系统授权的内容文件: Only files authorized by the system picker are accepted
exact.无法创建输入缓存: Unable to create the input cache
exact.可用空间不足，请先导出并清理结果: Not enough storage. Export and clear results first.
exact.应用内结果超过 2 GiB，请先导出并清理: App results exceed 2 GiB. Export and clear results first.
exact.所选文件不支持此工具，请重新选择: This tool does not support the selected files
exact.手机没有对应音频解码能力: Your device has no compatible audio decoder
exact.Live Photo的视频已移除，请重新导入照片和视频: The Live Photo video was removed. Import the photo and video again.
exact.合并需要至少两份 PDF: Select at least two PDFs to merge
exact.没有生成可导出的文件，压缩包可能为空: No output files were generated. The archive may be empty.
exact.结果文件不存在，可能已被清理: Result not found. It may have been cleared.
exact.无法打开保存位置: Unable to open the save location
exact.只有图片或视频可以保存到相册: Only images and videos can be saved to Photos
exact.无法创建相册文件: Unable to create a photo library entry
exact.无法发布相册文件: Unable to publish the photo library entry
exact.记录已移除，部分缓存未能删除: Records removed. Some cached files could not be deleted.
exact.文件夹不支持创建文件: This folder does not support creating files
exact.手机未能解码这一帧，请更换视频或截取范围: Unable to decode this frame. Try another video or time range.
exact.这组GIF参数处理量过大，请降低尺寸、帧率或时长: This GIF would exceed the processing budget. Reduce size, frame rate or duration.
exact.GIF超过128MiB，请降低尺寸或帧率: GIF exceeds 128 MiB. Reduce size or frame rate.
exact.编码器没有生成可用的视频: The encoder did not produce a usable video
exact.输出实际编码与所选编码不一致: The output codec does not match the selected codec
exact.视频编码器未能及时释放资源，任务已取消: The video encoder did not release resources in time. Task cancelled.
exact.截取时间需要在0–86400秒之间: Trim time must be between 0 and 86,400 seconds
exact.截取结束时间需要大于开始时间，且在视频时长内: End time must be after start and within the video duration
exact.GIF最多60秒，请缩短截取范围: GIF is limited to 60 seconds. Shorten the clip.
exact.动态照片的视频不完整: The Motion Photo video is incomplete
exact.PDF 不允许提取内容: This PDF does not allow content extraction
exact.合并结果页数过多: The merged PDF has too many pages
exact.文件超过安全处理上限: File exceeds the safe processing limit
exact.页码有误，请使用 1-3,5 且不超出文档范围: Invalid page range. Use 1-3,5 within the document page count.
exact.没有可提取的文字：扫描件需要 OCR，本版尚未提供: No text can be extracted. Scanned pages need OCR, which is not available.
exact.文档支持 TXT、MD、HTML、DOCX 和文字型 PDF；不支持旧版 DOC: Documents support TXT, MD, HTML, DOCX and text PDFs. Legacy DOC and PPT are unsupported.
exact.文字过长，请分段转换: Text is too long. Split it into smaller parts.
exact.JSON 数组内的元素类型应保持一致: Elements in the JSON array must use the same type
exact.表格支持 CSV、TSV、JSON 和 XLSX；不支持旧版 XLS: Spreadsheets support CSV, TSV, JSON and XLSX. Legacy XLS is unsupported.
exact.压缩包存在重复路径，为避免覆盖已停止: Archive has duplicate paths. Stopped to avoid overwriting files.
exact.无法创建解压目录: Unable to create the extraction folder
exact.压缩包名称重复，请分次解压: Archive names conflict. Extract them separately.
exact.解压总量超过安全上限: Expanded content exceeds the safe size limit
exact.本版支持 RAR4，不支持 RAR5 或分卷 RAR: RAR4 is supported. RAR5 and multipart RAR are unsupported.
exact.为防止路径跳转，不解压链接和设备条目: Links and device entries are skipped to prevent path traversal
exact.直接提取 M4A 仅支持 AAC 音轨。其他音轨可选择转 WAV。: Direct M4A extraction requires AAC. For other audio tracks, choose WAV.
exact.此解码器未输出 16 位 PCM: This decoder did not output 16-bit PCM
exact.解码后文件超过安全上限: Decoded output exceeds the safe size limit
exact.文档包含不允许的 XML 声明: Document contains a disallowed XML declaration

rules.en: Your device cannot play this file: {1}

rules.re: ^无法解码图片：(.*)。HEIC/AVIF 等格式取决于系统支持；GIF 只转换首帧。$
rules.en: Unable to decode {1}. HEIC/AVIF depend on device support. Only the first GIF frame is converted.

rules.re: ^系统未允许启动后台转换服务：(.*)$
^结果已保留，但状态保存失败：(.*)$
rules.en: Results are kept, but saving task state failed: {1}

rules.re: ^这台手机没有(.*)编码器；不会替换成其他编码$
rules.en: This device has no {1} encoder. The codec will not be substituted.
